comment: Fork's promoted evaluators for the page (DESIGN.md §5.5), oldest first. Every value below is copied from docs/nets.md and docs/history/phase-4/sprt-log.md (2026-11-07); the build (.github/workflows/web.yml) adds each module's file, size and SHA-256. scale is the output scale S the evaluation bar reads scores with (docs/nets.md); the bootstrap evaluation has none of its own, so it takes 134, the S with which B0's training read the bootstrap's labels (docs/nets.md, B0). Each validation loss is on its own data's held-out games, so losses on different data are not comparable.

networks.name: Bootstrap
networks.architecture: Fork's hand-written evaluation (Phase 3), where every network's chain begins

networks.name: B0
networks.data: generation-0 snapshot g0s1: 99,775 games, 9,535,083 positions of Fork self-play with the bootstrap evaluation

networks.name: B0r2
networks.data: generation-1 snapshot g1s1: 1,505,322 games, 150,117,509 positions of Fork self-play labelled by B0r1

networks.name: S512
networks.architecture: 768 inputs per perspective, mirrored left-right, -> 512 SCReLU -> 8 outputs, one picked by game phase

networks.name: S512r2
networks.architecture: S512's (768 mirrored -> 512 SCReLU -> 8 outputs by game phase), retrained
networks.data: generation-2 snapshot g2s1: 9,176,386 games, 614,769,222 saved positions labelled by S512

networks.name: S512+PP
networks.architecture: S512's (768 mirrored -> 512 SCReLU -> 8 outputs by game phase) plus 608 pawn-link inputs, one per pair of pawns at most one rank apart
networks.data: generation-2 snapshot g2s1 and generation-3 snapshot g3s1: 16,498,106 games, 988,611,737 saved positions labelled by S512 and S512r2

networks.name: S512ppr2
networks.architecture: S512+PP's (S512's inputs plus 608 pawn-link inputs), retrained warm from S512+PP
networks.data: generation-3 snapshot g3s2: g2s1, g3s1 and every generation-3 part since (labelled by S512 and S512r2), with a Syzygy-labelled endgame slice of about 26 million positions; about 1.24 billion positions

networks.name: S512ppr3
networks.architecture: S512+PP's (S512's inputs plus 608 pawn-link inputs), retrained warm from S512ppr2
networks.data: generation-3 snapshot g3s3: g3s2 plus the parts g3f and g3g (labelled by S512+PP and S512ppr2), with the Syzygy-labelled endgame slice; 101 training files
